text: An interface shows steadily incrementing CRC errors on a link that is up at full speed. What class of fault does this indicate?
choices: A physical-layer problem — cable, connector, EMI or a failing transceiver
explanation: A CRC error means the frame arrived corrupted, which is a physical-layer symptom and not a congestion one. Congestion produces output drops, not CRC errors. This is the counter that catches a marginal cable that passes a continuity test and still caps TCP throughput.
